name: p36_assoc_feature_tap_smoke
title: Biohub P36 Assoc Feature Tap Smoke
purpose: GATE 1 of the association harness, REDESIGNED as passive instrumentation (PKT-0029, host order 2026-08-30). Three attempts at this gate produced six distinct defects and every one was a REIMPLEMENTATION of the deployed path - the import boundary (FACT-0387), the mount root (FACT-0397), the launcher env (FACT-0399), a method name the class has never had, the image pipeline (FACT-0400), and a per-frame feature cache that cannot be faithful because TemporalUNet3D mixes across the window. This kernel reimplements nothing. scripts/kaggle_edits/assoc_feature_tap.py injects a PASSIVE tap into the deployed predict_video by source rewriting - the pattern every working patch in this tree uses - and records the exact tensors handed to model.predict_edges together with the deployed probabilities computed one line later. Insertion is the only edit, and the kernel re-proves that from disk: stripping the marked spans must restore the pre-patch sha256, so the emitted graph is identical to its control. scripts/win_bet/assoc_tap_replay.py then reloads the persisted cache IN A FRESH PROCESS and re-runs ONLY the head, comparing both bands against the SAME run's record - band A the deployed edges above 0.5, band B the sub-threshold surface down to 0.02, which FACT-0382 makes mandatory. Two crops, recording capped at eight frame pairs each. No submission.
